partition.assignment: Deterministic greedy bin packing by weight (d/2+1)^3, tie-broken by shard index; rows inside each shard retain manifest order.
partition.expected_coverage: All 178 FULL178 rows exactly once; each row contains every historical b-shard cell exactly once.
partition.certificate: One compact canonical JSON certificate per completed row shard.
partition.union_verification: Reconstruct the source-locked deterministic partition; require shards 0..15 exactly once; reject row gaps/overlaps/source-lock drift; sum exact Fraction objectives and cellwise integer floors; reconstruct diagnostic stream in original row/b-shard order.

carry_over.reuse_rule: Download same-index certificate from carry_run_id; reuse only when canonical digest, producer blob, worker blob, shard index/count and assignment digest validate under the current locked worker. Otherwise recompute that shard.
carry_over.missing_or_rejected_rule: Compute only the missing or rejected shard; never rerun a validated carried shard.
carry_over.cross_generation_requirement: Producer, worker, partition algorithm and shard_count must remain byte/semantically locked. A drift invalidates carry-over and forces recomputation of affected certificates.

cancellation_recovery.completed_units: Each completed shard uploads its certificate immediately before the job ends.
cancellation_recovery.cancelled_or_timed_out_units: No completion is inferred from a job container or partial file. Re-arm a fresh runkey generation with carry_run_id set to the cancelled/failed run; validated completed shards are salvaged and only unfinished shards are computed.

progress.format: HPADJ20_SHARD_PROGRESS shard=i/16 row=k/n row_id=... d=... elapsed_s=... eta_s=...

storage_preflight.cleanup_point: Shard artifacts expire after one day; only the compact final union certificate is retained for the audit window.
storage_preflight.stop_condition: Fail before upload if any shard certificate exceeds 2,000,000 bytes or the final union certificate exceeds 2,000,000 bytes. No raw search state is uploaded.

authorization.automatic_event: pull_request synchronize/opened only when the dedicated runkey path changed in the triggering range
authorization.workflow_dispatch_after_default_branch_i: Exact-head manual rerun remains available, still source/runkey locked.
